# OIP-Bench pilot report (Ollama models, auto-generated by bench/report.py)

Updated 2026-10-02 07:11. 20 VinDr-CXR images (seed 0), packages generated without radiologist boxes (no-leakage rule). Conditions: raw = canonical PNG only; ctx = PNG + context.md; annot = annotated PNG + context.md. Understanding tasks gate releases (D-015); findings F1 is reported only. Misleading test: a wrong finding label given as a bare prior-report note vs inside context.md's External section.
